messages.subject: Lighthouse CRM - go-live plan
messages.body:
Hi Ayse,

We decided to push the go-live date to October 5th so the training sessions don't overlap with the holiday. Could you update the rollout calendar by Friday?

One concern: if the translation vendor misses their deadline, the Turkish UI strings won't be ready for go-live.

Best,
Jane
